name: Grocery / Supermarket
persona_rules:
- Retrieve product prices, availability, and stock strictly from tools.
- Confirm exact quantities and suggest approved substitute brands for any out-of-stock items.
- Always confirm the complete delivery address, contact number, and total order sum before placing an order.

defaults.persona: You are a helpful grocery ordering assistant helping customers browse supermarket essentials, check product availability, and place delivery orders.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order value for free delivery?
faqs.answer: Free delivery applies to orders above [ADD MINIMUM ORDER AMOUNT, e.g. QAR 100]. For smaller orders, a delivery fee of [ADD DELIVERY FEE] applies.

faqs.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: We currently deliver to [ADD COVERAGE NEIGHBORHOODS / ZONES].

faqs.question: How long does home delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes [ADD STANDARD DELIVERY TIME, e.g. 60-90 minutes], while express delivery arrives within [ADD EXPRESS TIME].

faqs.question: What payment methods are supported on delivery?
faqs.answer: We accept cash on delivery, card on delivery via portable POS machines, and online payment links [ADD DETAILS].

faqs.question: What happens if an item I ordered is out of stock?
faqs.answer: Our shopper will propose an equivalent replacement brand or remove the item and deduct its cost before dispatch [ADD DETAILS].

faqs.question: Where is the physical supermarket located?
faqs.answer: Our main store is located at [ADD STORE ADDRESS AND TIMINGS].

faqs.question: What is your return policy for perishable fresh food?
faqs.answer: Fresh fruits, vegetables, and dairy can be inspected at delivery; issues reported within [ADD TIMELINE, e.g. 4 hours] will be refunded or replaced immediately.

faqs.question: Can I pick up my order in-store?
faqs.answer: Yes, choose Store Pickup and your groceries will be packed and waiting for you at customer service [ADD DETAILS].

faqs.question: Do you sell organic or gluten-free specialty products?
faqs.answer: Yes, we stock a wide range of organic, gluten-free, and vegan specialty brands in our organic aisle [ADD DETAILS].

defaults.reminder_24h: Hi {name} 👋 Your grocery delivery slot is scheduled for tomorrow at {time}.
defaults.reminder_1h: Hi {name}, your grocery order is packed and our driver is on the way for delivery around {time}!
defaults.followup: Hi {name} 👋 Just checking in to make sure your grocery order arrived fresh and complete. Need anything else today?
defaults.review: Hi {name}, thank you for ordering with us! How was your grocery delivery today? Please leave us a quick review: {link}
